record.body:
## Problem

Agents burning tokens and round-trips on the adaptive-artifacts CLI: qualified type names on every mutator, mandatory --expected-revision with a prior get/list, multi-command view regen, weak list/get output shaping, and store discovery broken by worktrees and a zsh --store wrapper. The 2026-10-14 trace synthesis and archived commitment aa-cli-and-ergonomics name bin/aa plus six concrete runtime areas.

## Approach

not yet scoped — choose among discuss options (one phase vs split; compat posture; whether views/ immutability exemption ships in this phase).

## Exit criteria

1. `bin/aa` is installed alongside `adaptive-artifacts` and resolves the same CLI — verified by a CLI smoke test invoking both entry points.
2. Each of the six approved optimization areas has automated tests under `tools/runtime/tests/` — verified by `python3 -m pytest tools/runtime/tests -q` green for the new coverage.
3. Agents (or a scripted replay of common se-workflow CLI patterns) can complete create→update without a preceding list/get solely for revision — verified by an integration or documented fixture command that uses `@current` / subject targeting.
4. Regenerating views does not fail validate on dirty `<store>/views/*.md` when that exemption is in scope — verified by a validation test (or explicitly deferred if option excludes it).

## Landing

- Branch: `phase/aa-cli-surface`
- Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/adaptive-artifacts--aa-cli-surface`
- Base: `master`
- Close: commit code on the phase branch; merge that branch into `master`; commit the store on the primary checkout (`/home/andrewyin/adaptive-artifacts`).
